senses.gloss: the effect of the sharp edge, cut.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 8a:1">Ḥull. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>חִידּוּדָהּ קודם וכ׳</he> (in cutting with a heated knife) the effect of its edge precedes the effect of the heat.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:5">Kel. II, 5</cite> <he>ויש לו ח׳</he> and (the lid) has a pointed knob (which prevents the use of it separately as a receptacle).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:5">Ib.</cite> <he>ואין לו ח׳</he> (ed. Dehr. <he>ואינו חָדוּד</he>, v. <cite ref="H00175"><he>חָדַד</he></cite>). Ib. IV, 1 <he>או שהיה בו ח׳</he> or (the vessel cannot stand straight) because it has a pointed bottom which makes it incline; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חִידּוּדִים</he>, <he>חִידּוּדִין</he>, <cite ref="H00665"><he>חִדּ׳</he></cite>. Ib. 3 <he>היו בה ח׳ יוצאין</he> if there are prongs projecting from the bottom of the misshaped vessel.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 94a:10">Snh. 94ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>ויחד</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 18:9">Ex. XVIII, 9</cite>) <he>נעשה בשרו ח׳ ח׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) he felt like cuts in his body; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 268:7">Yalk. Ex. 268</cite> <he>חי׳ חי׳</he>.
